evidence_identity_types.LIVE_REPOSITORY_OBSERVATION: freshly reacquired default-branch Git identity for the claim being made
evidence_identity_types.EPOCH_CURRENTNESS_CARRIER: immutable carrier binding a stabilized epoch subject
evidence_identity_types.SOURCE_BOUND_PROJECTION: deterministic projection bound to explicit source identities
evidence_identity_types.CANDIDATE_BINDING: pre-integration candidate identity used by formalization/verification
evidence_identity_types.HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE: immutable evidence of a past event or architecture epoch

REPOSITORY_CURRENT.rule: repository state must be reacquired for the claim being made; stored snapshots are source-bound evidence, not self-refreshing live truth

DOCUMENT_CURRENT.rule: document source dependencies and invalidators must be current for the document claim

PUBLIC_ENTRYPOINT_CURRENT.rule: public/project entrypoints are declared architecture artifacts and must route to the current architecture epoch

PROJECTION_CURRENT.rule: projection digest derives from exact source-bound inputs; generator ownership must match the actual generator

FEDERATION_CURRENT.rule: all required repository observations are exact and reconciled for the bound epoch

RUNTIME_CURRENT.rule: never inferred from Git or documentation

RAG_CURRENT.rule: RAG is versioned knowledge, never live truth

FORMALIZATION_CURRENT.rule: exact candidate and all required surfaces close without UNKNOWN

invalidation_pipeline: public/project entrypoints invalidated when architecture epoch or routed currentness changes
regenerate machine projections from exact source-bound inputs
refresh public/project entrypoints before discoverability closes
